Street guides / 03

A café sign is only the beginning

Follow 카페 to the door, then use 커피, 차, and 디저트 to make sense of the menu.

Updated 2 October 2026

카페

Understand the place

카페 identifies a café; 커피 means coffee. A shop can display either word on its outside sign. Inside, menu headings often organize drinks and food. 차 means tea in a drink-menu context, while 디저트 identifies desserts. 빵집 is a bakery, with bread as the main clue.

Easy to mix up

차 also has other meanings, including a vehicle. A cup, drink names, and a café menu help you choose the tea meaning. 빵집 and 카페 can offer overlapping products, so the sign is a useful starting point rather than a complete menu.

A sign you might see

커피 · 차 · 디저트

A board reads 커피 · 차 · 디저트. Read it as three categories: coffee, tea, and dessert. You have identified what to look at next, but not the exact ingredients, price, or size. Those details belong to the individual menu item.

Try it on your next walk

Find 카페, then choose a category you would order from. Say 커피 or 차 before revealing the translation. Listen again and notice how a familiar drink becomes a readable Korean word.
